prompt: List the prime numbers below fifty, then explain in two sentences why there are infinitely many primes.
description: Public correctness drift tripwire for ornith-1.5-35b-a3b-gguf-r9700-v1
note: Public tripwire for Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B Q4_K_M on llama.cpp HIP. The ranked gate is perplexity equivalence over a fixed corpus (<=0.1% relative delta) measured by the trusted runner; the golden hash is null because greedy text is not the ranked criterion. Two cautions specific to this track, both measured: a 512-token prefill dispatches MMQ, so a matvec block-shape change is NOT covered by the perplexity gate and needs a greedy-output hash as well; and conversely a greedy hash does not catch a change that reassociates the reduction feeding top-k expert selection, which on a 256-expert MoE re-draws which experts a token routes to. Neither check alone is sufficient here.
